feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. This is the final iteration, so this feedback has no later iteration to act on, and I record it for the record. The candidate is the iteration 6 geometry with the iteration 6 controller, which scored 70.83 in iterations 6 and 10. Iteration 9 (wheel_track 0.14 m, 69.05) showed that slower turning did not remove the s-bend and slalom line losses. Iteration 8 (±0.04 m span, 36.6) and iteration 7 (8 mm footprints, 67.75) closed those levers. Iteration 5 (body_length 0.12 m) lowered the score, and iteration 3 (y 0.07 m) did not remove the loss. If a further iteration were run, the branches would be: if the score returns to about 70.8 with one line loss per run, test wheel_radius 0.035 m alone, since it is the only untested single lever and raises speed and turn rate together. If the score falls clearly below 70.8 with losses unchanged, keep the iteration 6 geometry without further changes.
requested_changes: If a further iteration is available and the iteration 10 score is near 70.8 with line_loss_events still at 1.0 per run on the s-bend and slalom, test wheel_radius 0.035 m alone with all other fields as in iteration 6. Do not use a sensor span beyond ±0.03 m or 8 mm footprints in any later design. The ±0.04 m span scored 36.6 (iteration 8) and 8 mm scored 67.7 (iteration 7), so both are closed.
If the score falls clearly below 70.8 with line losses unchanged, return to the iteration 6 design (wheel_track 0.12 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m) with no further geometry changes (iterations 6 to 9).
